company.name: Avo
company.shortDescription: Avo is a leading data quality platform for product analytics. Adobe, Fender & Ikea use Avo to plan, implement & verify data 10x faster.
company.description:
Avo creates one source of truth for analytics events and generates personalized tracking libraries that give developers dev time validation that implementation is correct. 

Avo is a toolbox (UI and dev tool) to define event based analytics, and generate personalized tracking libraries that provide dev time validation of correct implementation. It's like a spell-checker for people to define quality data, and a type-checker for developers to make sure they send analytics according to design.
